hooks.text: After millions of miles, this shuttle faced a traffic jam.
NASA towed a 170,000-pound spaceship down 12 miles of city streets.
This spaceship flew 123 million miles but couldn't clear a curb.

title: The Slowest Journey of Space Shuttle Endeavour
description: After logging 123 million miles in orbit, Space Shuttle Endeavour faced its toughest mission yet: navigating 12 miles of urban Los Angeles.

beats.text: After millions of miles, this shuttle faced a traffic jam.
beats.visual: Space Shuttle Endeavour moving through Los Angeles streets surrounded by crowds, 2012
queries: Space Shuttle Endeavour Los Angeles street transport

beats.text: It was built from spare structural parts left over from other orbiters.
beats.visual: Assembly of the Space Shuttle Endeavour using spare components at Rockwell, 1987

beats.text: The massive journey across the city took 68 hours.
beats.visual: Endeavour moving past buildings on a multi-axle transport vehicle, 2012

beats.text: Crews cut down over 400 trees to clear the wide wings.
beats.visual: Arborists removing street trees in Los Angeles for the shuttle path, 2012

beats.text: Workers pulled down traffic lights and shut off high-voltage power lines.
beats.visual: Utility workers lifting power lines to allow the shuttle to pass underneath, 2012

beats.text: The shuttle squeezed past apartment buildings with only inches of clearance.
beats.visual: Close-up of Endeavour's wingtip nearly touching a Los Angeles building, 2012

beats.text: The spacecraft survived orbit, but city streets were its slowest mission yet.
beats.visual: Endeavour arriving at the California Science Center entrance, 2012
